description: Manages user-defined saved search filters, allowing users to store and reuse complex search criteria for various entities.

endpoints.name: CreateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Create a new saved filter. This allows users to store complex search criteria for later reuse. The `SearchCriteria` parameter should be a JSON string representing an array of search conditions, each with a `field`, `operator`, and `value`. For example: `[{"field":"Name","operator":"contains","value":"Project A"},{"field":"Status","operator":"is","value":"Active"}]`. The `IsAdvancedSearch` flag must be set to `true` if `SearchCriteria` is used, otherwise `SearchText` can be used for simple keyword searches.
example_uses: Create a saved filter named 'Active Projects' for the 'Project' entity, searching for projects with status 'Active'.
Save a filter for 'Contact' entity, searching for contacts named 'John Doe' using advanced search criteria.
Store a simple keyword search 'urgent' as a saved filter for 'Tasks'.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to save a specific set of search parameters (either simple text or advanced criteria) for future use, associated with a particular entity type.

endpoints.name: UpdateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Update an existing saved filter. This allows modification of its name, description, search criteria, or other properties. The `SearchCriteria` parameter should be a JSON string representing an array of search conditions, each with a `field`, `operator`, and `value`. For example: `[{"field":"Name","operator":"contains","value":"Project A"},{"field":"Status","operator":"is","value":"Active"}]`. The `IsAdvancedSearch` flag must be set to `true` if `SearchCriteria` is used, otherwise `SearchText` can be used for simple keyword searches.
example_uses: Update the saved filter with ID 123 to change its name to 'Completed Tasks'.
Modify the search criteria of an existing filter to include a new condition.
Change the sorting order of a saved filter.
endpoints.when_to_use: When an existing saved filter needs to have its properties, such as name, description, or search logic, modified.

endpoints.name: DeleteSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Delete a specific saved filter by its ID.
example_uses: Delete the saved filter with ID 456.
Remove a no longer needed search filter.
Can you delete the filter I created yesterday?
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to permanently remove a saved filter.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Retrieve the details of a specific saved filter by its unique ID.
example_uses: Get the details of saved filter ID 789.
Show me the configuration for my 'High Priority' filter.
Retrieve the saved filter with identifier 101.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to view the specific configuration or properties of a single saved filter.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilters
endpoints.description: Get a paginated list of all saved filters for the current user, with optional filtering by entity type or search text. This endpoint supports pagination and sorting. The `SearchText` parameter can be used for simple keyword searches across filter names and descriptions. `OrderBy` specifies the field to sort by, and `Ascending` or `Direction` specifies the sort order.
example_uses: List all my saved filters.
Show me saved filters related to 'Project' entity, sorted by name.
Get the second page of saved filters, with 20 items per page.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to browse or search through their collection of saved filters, potentially filtering by entity type or keywords, and needs pagination.

endpoints.name: ApplySavedFilter
endpoints.description: Apply a saved filter by its ID and retrieve the corresponding filter request object. This object can then be used to query the actual data for the entity the filter was saved for. Pagination parameters (`pageIndex`, `pageSize`) can be overridden here.
example_uses: Apply the saved filter with ID 123 and get the search parameters.
Retrieve the search criteria for my 'Urgent Tasks' filter.
What are the search parameters for filter 456, but with 50 items per page?
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to retrieve the actual search criteria (e.g., `SearchCriteria` JSON string, `SearchText`, `OrderBy`, `IsAdvancedSearch`) stored within a saved filter, to then apply it to another search endpoint.

endpoints.name: GetFilterStatistics
endpoints.description: Get usage statistics for saved filters, optionally filtered by entity type. This provides insights into how filters are being used.
example_uses: Show me the statistics for all saved filters.
How many saved filters are there for the 'Contact' entity?
Provide usage data for saved filters.
endpoints.when_to_use: When an administrator or user needs to understand the usage patterns or popularity of saved filters, possibly per entity type.
